Strategy: Score favors bins whose leftover is about a quarter of the bin residual, meaning the item fills roughly three quarters of that bin, regardless of absolute sizes. The ranking differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin is nearly full or nearly empty in relative terms. It may help by balancing fill ratios across bins, or fail because relative fullness ignores absolute leftover usability.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs((r - item) / r - 0.25) for r in bins]
```
